description: EXPLICIT CANDIDATES ONLY, NOT LIVE-QUALIFIED: CoinGecko asset ID -> proposed Binance Spot base symbol. Live exchangeInfo and complete verified OHLCV required before archival.

manual_review.tether: Quote asset USDT itself; USDTUSDT is not a valid meaningful Spot price history.
manual_review.figure-heloc: Tokenized asset; ticker FIGR_HELOC is not a vetted Binance Spot base asset.
manual_review.whitebit: Venue-specific coin; cross-exchange ticker ownership not established.
manual_review.rain: RAIN ticker may collide with a different issuer.
manual_review.canton-network: CC ticker collision/issuer identity requires separate evidence.
manual_review.bitway: BTW identity is insufficient to assign a Binance Spot instrument.
manual_review.the-open-network: Snapshot symbol GRAM is not interchangeable with TON.
manual_review.hashnote-usyc: Tokenized yield fund; requires asset-specific verified instrument.
manual_review.ondo-us-dollar-yield: Yield token; don't confuse with ONDO spot token.
manual_review.memecore: Ticker M is ambiguous; symbol-only matching can attach a different token.
manual_review.blackrock-usd-institutional-digital-liqu: Institutional tokenized fund, not an assumed public USDT Spot instrument.
